title: Bank v1, sitting 2 of 2: numbers, short answers, pauses and long turns in room A; a TV, facing away, about 5 m; room B near and about 3 m
note: Positions name the distances the design's table gives; write the measured metres into distance_m before the sitting if a tape was used. Each sitting records its own room tone, so either one stands without the other. The second voice's class is left out until someone gives written consent (D7, decided 2026-10-27). The table's room responses are left out too: the microphone's automatic gain control is on (amixer -c 3, read 2026-10-28), and a swept-sine response assumes a gain that holds still through the sweep; nothing reads a response before the generated bank of stage 2, which records them with that control off, if the maintainer decides so.

lo01.text: hey emet, I want to tell you about my day. I woke up early, made coffee, and walked to the station in the rain. The train was late again, so I read for a while and watched the people on the platform. At work we planned the new garden by the car park, and after lunch I fixed the printer twice. What do you think I should cook tonight?

lo02.text: hey emet, here is a story my grandmother used to tell. A fox lived at the edge of a village, and every winter it came down to the farms looking for food. One year a little girl left bread on the wall for it, every evening, until the snow melted. In the spring the fox came back with three cubs and sat on the wall to watch her. Do you like that story?
